heading: From solo builders to staff engineers
description: Helix is in production with founders, PMs, engineering leads, and agencies shipping AI-generated code without the 2,000-line PRs.

testimonials.quote: Helix turned a sprawling AI refactor into a stack of small, reviewable PRs. Our team finally trusts the diff queue again.
testimonials.author: Priya Subramanian

testimonials.quote: We deploy Helix runs to Vercel on every merge. The atomic units make rollbacks boring — which is the best kind of rollback.
testimonials.author: Marcus Lee

testimonials.quote: As a PM, I finally know what shipped and why. Helix surfaces the unit-level story behind every AI change.
testimonials.author: Jordan Park
